subject.title: [Feature]: Sidebar update card (web + macOS) with app-first macOS update flow and Sparkle stable/beta track

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the full coordinated update flow, including a signed-app native bridge, prompt-free repair only for app-managed gateways, and mapping gateway beta/dev channels to Sparkle beta eligibility?
rationale: The implementation seams and dependency contract are clear, but this deliberately changes persistent UI placement, a privileged web-to-native action, upgrade prompt behavior, and prerelease distribution policy; the protected maintainer label also requires explicit human intent.

options.title: Adopt the coordinated flow
options.body: Implement the sidebar card, constrained app-first Sparkle handoff, managed-only post-relaunch repair, and one-feed beta channel mapping.

options.title: Stage the changes
options.body: Land the persistent sidebar card first and keep native auto-repair and beta distribution as separately approved follow-ups.

options.title: Keep current separation
options.body: Retain the transient banner, prompt-gated gateway repair, and stable-only macOS appcast.

recommendation.title: Adopt the coordinated flow
recommendation.body: Implement the sidebar card, constrained app-first Sparkle handoff, managed-only post-relaunch repair, and one-feed beta channel mapping.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced or recently owned the central macOS dashboard, managed gateway, sidebar, and release surfaces and authored this product-direction request.
